title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
title_zh: PlayCraft：利用智能体试玩经验设计更有吸引力的游戏
abstract_en: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning. We propose PlayCraft, an automated framework that uses a vision-based agent to play games and draws on its detailed play experience to revise them for mastery. Starting from an initial game, PlayCraft alternates between playing and crafting. In the playing stage, a player agent watches the game screen, uses the controls, and pursues the game objective over repeated episodes while retaining memory. After each episode, it reports its progress, outcomes, decisions, and reflections. In the crafting stage, a crafter agent uses these reports to revise the game. It estimates player abilities, predicts performance at different proficiency levels, and compares those predictions with a target learning progression. It diagnoses the game and addresses the gaps by giving players meaningful opportunities to improve through better decisions and execution. We evaluate games in fresh runs with player agents across three intelligence settings, measuring learning gain and learning slope. Compared with the initial games, PlayCraft yields larger learning gains and steeper learning slopes in most games. It also outperforms the baselines on the macro-average of each metric at every intelligence setting.
abstract_zh: 现有 AI 智能体已能生成可玩的游戏，但可玩并不意味着有吸引力。逐步掌握游戏技巧（mastery）是维持玩家投入的重要因素，而为此设计游戏通常需要大量人工试玩与调优。PlayCraft 提出一种自动化框架，交替执行试玩与改版：试玩智能体观察游戏画面、操作游戏并追求游戏目标，在多轮试玩中保留记忆，每轮结束后报告进展、结果、决策与反思；改版智能体根据这些报告估计玩家能力，预测不同熟练度下的表现，再与目标学习进程对照，找出差距并修改游戏，让玩家能通过更好的决策和操作取得进步。研究在三种智能水平设置下重新运行试玩实验，衡量学习增益（learning gain）和学习斜率（learning slope）。相较于初始版本，多数游戏的学习增益更大、学习斜率更陡；在每种智能水平设置下，两项指标的宏平均均优于基线方法。
key_points_zh: PlayCraft 将视觉试玩与游戏改版连成闭环，以减少为提升技巧掌握感而进行的人工试玩与调优。
试玩智能体跨轮保留记忆，并报告决策与反思，为改版提供比分数或胜负更丰富的依据。
改版智能体对照不同熟练度下的预测表现与目标学习进程，让更好的决策或操作能够带来实际进步。
三种智能水平设置下，学习增益和学习斜率的宏平均均优于基线；这些结果反映的是智能体的学习表现，并非对人类玩家投入度的直接测量。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 玩家代理在同一游戏中跨局复用经验，研究系统测量其表现进步；改写的是游戏代码，不是代理自身的运行框架或改进机制。
agent-harness-evolution.quote:
We assess support for mastery through performance improvement across repeated episodes of a fixed
game. We report learning gain to measure overall improvement, and learning slope to summarize the
direction and rate of performance change across all episodes.

agent-memory.reason: 同一会话内跨局合并、修订和删除自然语言经验，为比较仅保留历史与额外维护经验摘要提供了具体设计；实验未单独消融记忆机制。
agent-memory.quote:
The player then updates a consolidated set of natural-language lessons, retaining supported
lessons, merging overlapping ones, and revising or removing contradicted ones.

agent-multimodal.reason: 代理框架把连续游戏帧转成分段控制计划，并在十款游戏上系统评估交互表现；帧采样和动作间隔给出了可复现实验设置。

Frames are captured every
O = 200 ms, and the player makes a decision every W = 1,000 ms of active play. Each decision
